en-GB.color.gamma: Showing colour values in 0-255 gamma space
en-GB.color.linear: Showing colour values in 0-1 linear space
en-GB.render.background_not_light: Background colour is presentation, not an additional lighting source.
en-GB.render.bloom_help: Creative output-only glow from positive linear highlights, spread with three normalised box passes. Radius is in output pixels. Added in linear display light before sRGB; not a lens, volumetric effect or convergence improvement. The raw EXR is unchanged.
en-GB.render.cpu_light_help: Up to eight directional lights. An empty custom list turns them off; selecting a preset restores its lights. Colours are linear RGB and intensity is relative, not watts.
en-GB.render.hdr_primaries_declared: The source declares its colour primaries.
en-GB.render.hdr_primaries_undeclared: The source does not declare primaries; review the renderer colour requirements.
en-GB.render.library_inspect_only: Select to inspect; nothing is applied automatically. Favourites and recent history belong to this open document session.
en-GB.render.library_rig_help: Fit once at an explicit centre and physical extent. Complete rigs include passive cards; calibration blockers still refuse. Conservative emitter/card clearance is checked before saving.
en-GB.render.library_source_preview_help: Authored base-colour source map. This is not a rendered or measured material preview.
en-GB.render.material_map_required: Choose a colour image or a normal image before using maps.
en-GB.render.material_maps_help: PNG/JPEG up to 1024×1024; 16 MiB encoded total. U and V are orthogonal world-mm repeat vectors (maximum 128 repeats). Colour is sRGB; normal data uses OpenGL +Y. Files are captured at Check/Start.
en-GB.render.studio_hdr_help: Radiance .hdr, 2:1 panorama, up to 2048 × 1024. EXR is unavailable. The colour assumption applies only when primaries are unspecified.
en-GB.ui.3d_mouse_looks_like_cap: The reading stays put while you hold it, the way a Return to Centre device does.
en-GB.ui.center_arc_follows_cursor: Centre point arc follows the cursor's direction
en-GB.ui.center_arc_follows_cursor_tip: A centre point arc runs clockwise or counter-clockwise the way the cursor goes round its centre. Off: always counter-clockwise from the start.
